//: This file is read when Vercel's Root Directory is set to `client`.
The repo-root vercel.json is used instead when Root Directory is blank -
Vercel only reads the one inside the configured root.
The /api rewrite is what keeps the SPA and API same-origin. That is not
cosmetic: the refresh token lives in a SameSite=Lax httpOnly cookie, and
pointing the browser straight at the Render origin would make it a
third-party cookie that Safari and Brave drop - silently breaking
'stay signed in'. Leave VITE_API_BASE_URL unset so it keeps its /api/v1
default and travels through this rewrite.
